treatment.schedule_summary: 2 mg/m² IV over 60 minutes: twice weekly at least 3 days apart for 12 weeks, then weekly for 24 weeks; 48 infusions over 36 weeks after surgery.

eligibility: High-grade resectable non-metastatic osteosarcoma after macroscopically complete resection and surgical recovery.
NCCP age 2–30; EMA studied age at initial diagnosis must be distinguished.
Postoperative multi-agent chemotherapy plan; adequate haematological, hepatic and renal function.
exclusions: Metastatic disease at presentation or incomplete resection.
Prior chemotherapy/radiotherapy other than preoperative multi-agent chemotherapy.
Concurrent calcineurin inhibitor or high-dose NSAID use is contraindicated.
monitoring: FBC, renal and liver profile at baseline and before each cycle; continue renal/liver surveillance until mifamurtide is complete.
Echocardiography annually or according to local practice.
Monitor fever, breathing, cardiovascular and inflammatory reactions during administration.
EMA supplementary monitoring: clotting parameters after the first and again after several doses.
dose_modifications: CrCl ≥30 and Child–Pugh A/B: no routine dose adjustment; moderate hepatic impairment requires caution.
Severe renal/hepatic impairment: no pharmacokinetic data; specialist decision.
Severe respiratory reaction: discontinue administration. Persistent worsening cardiovascular symptoms: delay/discontinue.

supportive_care.mapping_basis: Risk assigned from the most emetogenic active component and treatment phase.
supportive_care.supportive_medications_label: NCCP antiemetic guidance for moderate emetogenic risk

Preparation filtration differs from avoiding an administration in-line filter.
premedications: Paracetamol/chlorphenamine may be used under an individual prescription; fixed source examples require paediatric dose review.
Avoid routine dexamethasone or other chronic/routine steroids.
